name: Venice
tagline: A city without cars, arrived at by water.
distinctive: There is no arrival like Venice's: a water taxi across the lagoon to a palazzo landing stage. It is at its best early in the morning and late at night, when the day visitors have gone.

image.alt: Water taxis on the Grand Canal approaching the Rialto Bridge at golden hour

moodNotes.art: Byzantine mosaics, Titian and Tintoretto, the Peggy Guggenheim Collection and the Biennale.
moodNotes.lifetime: The water-taxi arrival across the lagoon is one of travel's great moments.
moodNotes.weekend: Marco Polo Airport is a short boat ride away, so the city works well for a long weekend.
moodNotes.city: Quiet after dark: bacari, a performance at La Fenice, a walk through empty squares.
moodNotes.sea: The lagoon and its islands rather than beaches.

seasonNote: Spring and autumn are gentler than the crowded, humid summer. Late autumn and winter can bring high water (acqua alta).

arrival.transfer: A private water taxi from Marco Polo takes roughly half an hour to the historic centre, and many hotels have their own landing stage.
arrival.groundNote: Pack light: bridges and steps are everywhere, and porters can meet your boat.

driving.note: The historic centre has no roads. Arrive by water taxi and travel on foot or by boat.

transfer.label: Private water taxi
transfer.why: Across the lagoon and into the Grand Canal, the arrival is the first great sight of the trip.

stay.name: Aman Venice
stay.why: A hotel in Palazzo Papadopoli, a sixteenth-century palazzo on the Grand Canal with frescoed interiors and private gardens.

watchWhy: A slim, quiet dress watch for evenings at La Fenice and dinners in candlelit palazzi.
aromaWhy: Warm amber resin and lagoon salt, like an old palazzo interior on a winter afternoon.

days.title: Arrive by water
days.text: Cross by water taxi to the hotel's landing stage. In the evening, drift between bacari for cicchetti.

days.title: San Marco early
days.text: Visit the Basilica early, then the Doge's Palace. See the Peggy Guggenheim Collection in the afternoon, and a performance at La Fenice in the evening if one is scheduled.

days.title: The lagoon islands
days.text: Take a boat to Torcello for its cathedral mosaics, then Burano's colours and a long lunch.

moreDays.title: The Biennale
moreDays.text: The Biennale alternates art and architecture exhibitions. Check what is on.

moreDays.title: Palladio on the Brenta
moreDays.text: Take a boat along the Brenta Canal to the Palladian villas.
